season.evidence: Stored season is empty. It shares the Wing Lake approach, which is snowbound into late June/early July and gets snow again in October; guide pages give the peak a late-spring-to-early-fall season, and all 16 successful logged ascents fall in Jul-Oct except one March ski trip. A snow-free class 3-4 scramble is a Jul-Oct objective.

otherTracksConsidered.why: No harvested ascent is logged as the East Buttress, and every track's line goes either by the NE-ridge notch (north-east of Wing Lake) or by the south col and ridge; none works the east side of the Wing Lake basin.

season.evidence: Stored May-Oct matches the Mountaineers' listing for this route. Logged NE Ridge ascents run July (2025) and October (2026, 2024), a June 2021 attempt turned back, and all-route ascents spread Jul-Oct with a March ski ascent that is irrelevant to the ridge. Stored Jul-mid-Sep optimum stands.

track.why: Jul 7 2025, logged NE Ridge, summited (18 m from our summit pin). Report: camped at Wing Lake, reached the ridge via the right-hand ledges, simul-climbed 5 pitches, scrambled the last bit unroped, descended the south route. The line leaves Wing Lake north-east to about 48.5269,-120.8112 (the NE-ridge notch) before turning to the summit, unlike the south-route tracks. Round trip from the Rainy Pass lot: start 72 m, end 61 m from our trailhead pin.

facts.text: Ice axe (early to mid July: the snow slope under the ridge can be steep; crampons depend on your boots)
Light rack of cams about 0.3-2 in, nuts and slings (five simul pitches on the ridge)
Mosquitoes are thick along the approach and at the lakes in early to mid July
Two ways reach the ridge from the basin: low-angle ledges on the right, or steep snow under undercut cliffs on the left. The ledges went in early July but carry loose gravel.
In July parties leaving the south ridge either pick down steep dirt or take the snow; dirt to lower-angle snow, then a glissade, worked, and the scree beside the snow sheds rock.
Protection is poor and sparse in places; early-October parties ran pitches out and threaded the rope around ridge features.
Shaded slopes below the scree can be icy and slick in the early-October morning until the sun softens them
In early October, fill bottles at Wing Lake; no reliable water higher on the climb.
On fine early-October weekends, larch-season crowds fill the Rainy Pass lots and line the highway shoulder; start early to secure parking.

notes: Neither the East Buttress nor any other route has a track unique to it; the East Buttress has no ascent evidence at all (the only mention found online is that it starts from Wing Lake). Our trailhead and summit pins are fine (trailhead 143 m from where nine tracks start, summit within 25 m of every track's high point and 0 m from Peakbagger's lidar summit). The East Buttress waypoint list gives the Heather Pass/Lewis Lake route as its approach, which is correct. Several 2026 October tracks show snow on the ground and a turn-back on Oct 12, so October is genuinely marginal. A month histogram was not supplied in the packet (dates were blank), so I counted from each report's own Date field: Jul 4, Jul 7 2025, Jul 19 2019, Aug 8 2025, Aug 24 2018, Sep 2 2018, Sep 28 2025, Oct x13 (several seasons), June 20 turn-back, March 7 ski.
